mainEntity.name: Does this account for highway vs city driving?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use your vehicle's combined MPG for a realistic estimate, or enter the city or highway figure that matches your trip.

mainEntity.name: How do I find my car's actual MPG?

acceptedAnswer.text: Divide the miles driven since your last full fill-up by the gallons it took to refill the tank. Tracking this over a few tanks gives a more reliable average than the rated figure. Our Gas Mileage Calculator does this.

mainEntity.name: Does this account for fuel price changes during a long trip?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It uses one price. For a long trip, enter the average price you expect to pay along the route.

mainEntity.name: Does driving style really affect fuel economy that much?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Aggressive acceleration and braking, high speeds and idling can reduce fuel economy noticeably compared with smooth, moderate driving, especially in stop-and-go traffic.
